Animate my brain

An illustrated short video of what it feels like when my brain is zooming in and out from a planet on fire to a microbe

Sounds like zwamp zwamp electronic noise with intersecting black and white stripes like those trippy things that make your eyes cross but clearly shows like and hourglass shape of in and out but at an angle.

Ends with an eye opening and looking weary then focusing and then panning to a cute lil plant and crinkling with a smile
